notes:
A hybrid compound combining the Japanese word ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧ (sightseeing) with the English loanword ⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧ (tour). This is the standard term for organized sightseeing excursions, whether day trips or multi-day packages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観光|かんこう}ツアー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧: to sign up for a tour
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧{観光|かんこう}ツアー: bus sightseeing tour
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧{観光|かんこう}ツアー: day-trip tour
- {観光|かんこう}ツアー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: tour reservation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧: tour (general; can refer to concert tours, business tours, etc.)
- {観光旅行|かんこうりょこう}: sightseeing trip (broader; includes independent travel, not just organized tours)
- ⟦{団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}→団体旅行：22453_dantairyokou⟧: group travel (focuses on traveling as a group, not necessarily sightseeing)
- {周遊|しゅうゆう}⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧: excursion tour (emphasizes visiting multiple destinations in a circuit)
